rulings: R64 EXTENDED (Drew, 2026-09-18): the 2026-09-11 ruling that Sonic is card 221's ONLY variation tier is REVERSED. TITLES DECIDE. Cited in full: (i) Ruling 23 / cardpedia-drew-ruling-2026-09-11 - '2022 Topps Chrome image variations have three tiers ... Sonic = Image Variation Sonic, its own card line; Witt Jr. #221 is Sonic per BCP -> mint from BCP, re-derive Witt'; and (ii) Ruling 24 (2026-09-12, 2026-09-12-witt-221-image-variation-to-sonic.json) - 'a title or field that states an image/photo variation but names NO tier resolves to Sonic for this card specifically, because Sonic is the only variation tier #221 has'. That premise is now withdrawn: the 15 pooled rows name four different products.

A TIER-BLIND 'variation' title still resolves to Sonic Lite's checklist-backed `Image Variations` row - that half of Ruling 24 stands. What is reversed is treating a title that NAMES a different product (Ben Baller, Refractor, SP) as tier-blind.

PARKED, NOT MINTED (Drew, 2026-09-18): the two plain 'IMAGE VARIATION SP' PSA 10 sales ($725, $1,050) are parked `identityUnverified`. The catalog attests NO SP/SSP row for #221 - Beckett's 30 SP/SSP image-variation rows for 2022 topps-chrome run 1-220 and exclude 221. NEVER MINT FROM SALES: absent beats wrong. An acquisition note is open for whether a #221 SP exists (Cardboard Connection / TCDB).
AXIS: setKey and parallel move together as ONE ruled axis (the variation identity). cardNumber, isAuto and every trailing segment carry through byte-identical on every relocated row.
Drew's holding (ebay-user-purchase::holding::2b62a93f-...) re-points to the REFRACTOR image variation row, per R64.

OCCUPANCY: all 3 destination catalog rows already exist (ben-baller short-print, sonic-lite image-variations, topps-chrome image-variation-refractor). NOTHING IS MINTED BY THIS LIST. Zero pool rows sit at any destination today, so every relocate is clean with no collision.

SPELLING: the Sonic destination parallel is 'Image Variations' - the only checklist-backed spelling for this card (checklistcenter, on topps-chrome-sonic-lite). 'Refractor Image Variation' (ebay-user-purchase) and 'Image Variation Refractor' (ingest-auto-seed) are ONE card in two spellings; the latter is kept because it is what the existing catalog row carries. Neither source is a checklist, so this spelling is a convention, not evidence.
